approach: I followed the DE-03 procedure in the data-engineering-steps skill. It reads feat.tasks and feat.design and writes task.db_changes. I read both inputs to find what storage the design puts in scope and which files the Data Engineering tasks (TSK-01 and TSK-02) may change. I checked this against the repository in two ways: the tool view, and my own file listing and search of ap_pipeline for database client code, DDL and migration patterns. Both showed no database. The output records an empty change register, explains why rollback and migration items do not apply, sends the logical paid_date change to DE-05 and carries the design's DQ-1 as a non-blocking question. No connector was needed, and I did not use any production data.
